name: folarin-bookstore
description: Discover free digital books from Folarin Bookstore and open accurate reading options.

interface.longDescription: Search Folarin Bookstore's free public-domain digital catalogue, check current availability, and open the correct Folarin page to read.
defaultPrompt: Find Pride and Prejudice in Folarin Bookstore.
Show me free books by Jane Austen.
What reading options does Folarin offer for The Odyssey?

positive.prompt: Find Pride and Prejudice in Folarin Bookstore.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant free-book matches with canonical Folarin links and qualified availability wording.

positive.prompt: Show me free books by Jane Austen.
positive.expected_behavior: Return bounded Jane Austen results from Folarin's public catalogue without claiming worldwide rights.

positive.description: Check whether a title is listed
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching Odyssey records and direct the user to the canonical Folarin page for current reading availability.

positive.description: Open details from an exact Folarin URL
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact published record, rights metadata, and canonical Folarin reading link.

positive.description: Find an author with accented characters
positive.prompt: Find free books by Niccolò Machiavelli.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant Machiavelli results without inventing titles or availability.

review.commerce_description: This initial plugin only discovers free public-domain books and does not sell products, subscriptions, or digital content.

publication.release_notes: Privacy remediation: expanded the published privacy notice to disclose the MCP tool inputs and outputs, purposes, recipients, retention periods, and user controls. The read-only catalogue tools, permissions, and MCP endpoint are unchanged.
